patches.title: Provider Context Controller seam before provider conversion
patches.genericRuntimeRationale: Any agent runtime consumer needs to decide systemPrompt/messages/tools completely before provider conversion without forcing Session.buildContext() (e.g. identity-level Context engines that do not derive messages from the Session archive). The default native Session-derived path is unchanged and byte-compatible when the controller is absent.
tests: packages/agent/test/harness/runtime-seams.test.ts (PI-015 controller path skips buildContext; provider receives controller systemPrompt/messages)
packages/agent/test/harness/runtime-seams.test.ts (PI-015 default path still calls buildContext and stays compatible)
patches.removalCondition: earendil-works/pi merges an equivalent pre-conversion context override seam and iris_agent rebases onto the released package containing it.
patches.compatibilityRisk: low: additive optional option; absent controller keeps the exact native code path.
patches.notes: Generic runtime seam; Iris cognitive policy (m0/m1/LKG, ContextMessageUnit) stays in iris_agent and is NOT part of this patch.

patches.title: Awaited Session commit receipts for appended entries
patches.genericRuntimeRationale: Consumers of the Session archive need awaited, durable commit evidence (sessionId, entryId, content hash, optional entrySeq) to attribute messages exactly once and to reconcile crash windows; observer-only events cannot prove durability. Receipts are carried on the new message_finalized lifecycle event; the Session append API itself keeps its existing return contract.
tests: packages/agent/test/harness/runtime-seams.test.ts (message_finalized carries a full receipt for every appended message)
patches.removalCondition: earendil-works/pi provides awaited append receipts (or an equivalent durability contract) and iris_agent consumes the released contract.
patches.compatibilityRisk: low: new additive event; no existing event or API shape is modified.
patches.notes: entrySeq is optional because the in-memory Session abstraction does not expose the storage-layer sequence; storage backends may fill it in later. 0.83.1: message_finalized now also carries the committed message (commit evidence completeness).

patches.title: Stable runtime lifecycle events (message finalized / turn committed / tool execution committed)
patches.genericRuntimeRationale: A generic agent runtime needs stable lifecycle events distinguishing message finalization, tool execution commit and turn commit from observer-level stream updates, so consumers can order user/tool/assistant boundaries and prove exactly-once attribution without scanning the Session archive.
patches.removalCondition: earendil-works/pi emits equivalent lifecycle events and iris_agent consumes the released contract.
patches.compatibilityRisk: low: additive events only; no existing event payload is changed.
patches.notes: settled/save_point/abort events already existed and are reused; the new events add the missing commit granularity.
